items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I did some recording with Carmen out here on Jimmy Jones' date.

ctx.x: at that time he couldn't travel because you know, they were on him. And it was a very unfortunate thing as I said, because he liked the group and we loved working with him. But we worked together with -- well, after that Billy Taylor got his own little group and I worked with Billy for quite a bit, and Joe Benjamin and Charlie Smith and myself stayed -- you know, we stayed with Billy, yeah. And we worked quite a few clubs, and did quite a bit of recording with Billy. You know.

So that was a very rewarding experience, and then I left. After that I came to California and stayed. I'm still here and I've done quite a bit of recording out here. And I recorded with -- speaking of singers, I did some recording with Carmen out here on Jimmy Jones' date.
